objective: Stop reducing a 158-field Moroccan population to a seven-column service road on the way into the named 2026 pipeline.
finding: The rich population exists (population_certificate_v1.json = PASS), its builders are in the repository, and the named 2026 voters carry 7 fields. This was wiring, not collection.

inputs.named_input: a current-vintage named 2026 input (territories, candidacies, programmes, conditions)
inputs.attitude_overlay: output of morocco26/scripts/agent_society_v2_build_attitude_overlay.py, JSONL, one row per (constituency_id, archetype_id)
inputs.crosswalk: optional JSON object mapping named territory_id to rich constituency_id, when the two identifier spaces differ

join.note: The named 2026 territories are real (ain-chock, ...) and the rich populations are keyed by real constituency_id, so the join opens no sealed mapping.

voter_row_layers.survey_stratum: Afrobarometer stratum means with their _sd and stratum n
voter_row_layers.territory_context: labour-market and territorial context, never a personal attribute

prior_election_anchor.reason: prior_vote_or_abstention in a rich record comes from the PRIOR_ELECTION_ANCHOR family. Importing it into a current-vintage 2026 snapshot would carry a sealed historical outcome into an environment that must not know it. Consequence: turnout_memory stays UNKNOWN and BR5 stays NOT_TESTABLE until the owner authorises it explicitly.

guards.forbidden_field_behaviour: hard error, never a silent filter
guards.stratum_fields: never enter the individual layer; V9.1 labels them SURVEY_STRATUM_PRIOR
guards.encdm_donor_fields: never enter the individual layer as observations; V9.1 labels them MATCHED_DONOR_LATENT_STATE

selection.rule: deterministic weight-proportional systematic sampling, start offset = sha256(snapshot_id, territory_id)
selection.distinctness: guaranteed; units heavier than one sampling step are not selected twice, the remaining slots go to the heaviest unselected units
selection.reproducibility: same environment and territory always yield the same people

identity_warning.statement: The A001..ANNN labels emitted here are re-issued from the rich population.
identity_warning.consequence: They are NOT the archetypes of the 2026-08-23 Ain Chock pilot. No traceable mapping exists between the seven-column named rows and any rich archetype, so a comparison with that pilot is between populations, not paired.
identity_warning.paired_design: R3 obtains a paired design by holding the rich population fixed across arms and varying only the mind layer.

measured_effect_on_a_shape_faithful_fixt.caveat: Measured on a shape-faithful synthetic fixture, not on Moroccan data. The real numbers must be re-measured once the CI builders publish a 2026 rich population.

still_required_before_r3_on_real_data: a rich population artifact for the 2026 target year, published by the existing CI builders
the matching attitude overlay for the same population
a territory crosswalk if the named territory_id space differs from the rich constituency_id space
